summary: LogicMark, Inc. filed an 8-K reporting the October 13, 2026 closing of its merger with Langham Project LLC and Langham Merger Sub, Inc. under a July 31, 2026 agreement. Each outstanding common share was canceled and converted into the right to receive $1.31 in cash, without interest, taking the company private as a wholly owned subsidiary. The registrant is the target; no advisor or board recommendation is named in the excerpt. Vested RSUs and in-the-money options cash out, unvested RSUs cancel for no consideration, warrants terminate, and dissenting holders may pursue Nevada fair-value appraisal. Watch for appraisal claims and any residual delisting mechanics.
